publication.title: Designing Scientific SPARQL Queries Using Autocompletion by Snippets
publication.version: 2018 HAL author version v2 for eScience

source_reading.scope: Abstract/context and needs elicitation, autocompletion comparison, algorithm/workflow overview and complete evaluation/conclusion (§§V–VI).

adjudication.basis: The primary report implements human SPARQL query authoring over RDF/Wikidata with snippet suggestions selected in an editor. This is an interactive semantic-query interface with guidance; the reported selection test supplies limited human evidence rather than a controlled task-effectiveness trial.
